title: The Blue Notebook Review with Sgt. Rick Verbeck - Nov. 23-29, 2025
description:
He’s Back.

The Blue Notebook Review returns with Sgt. Rick Verbeck.

In this episode, Sgt. Verbeck recaps activity from November 23–29, including:

A brief update on where he’s been
Notable arrests
Holiday deployment and staffing efforts
And more from a busy week across the city.

Plus, a little good-natured shade thrown at Android users… consider this your moment to unite!
